source_note: Facts cross-checked against the app's question bank and standard references.

bullets.en: Percentage: x% of N = (x/100) × N. Example: 20% of 500 = 100.
Profit% = (profit ÷ CP) × 100; Loss% = (loss ÷ CP) × 100. SP = CP × (1 ± p/100).
bullets.ne: नाफा% = (नाफा ÷ क्रयमूल्य) × 100; नोक्सान% = (नोक्सान ÷ क्रयमूल्य) × 100। विक्रयमूल्य = क्रयमूल्य × (1 ± p/100)।

bullets.en: Simple interest: SI = P×R×T/100; Amount = P + SI.
bullets.ne: साधारण ब्याज: ब्याज = मूलधन×दर×समय/100; मिश्रधन = मूलधन + ब्याज।

bullets.en: Compound interest: Amount = P(1 + R/100)^n; CI = Amount − P.
bullets.ne: चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज: मिश्रधन = P(1 + R/100)^n; ब्याज = मिश्रधन − मूलधन।

bullets.en: Speed = distance ÷ time. km/h → m/s: multiply by 5/18 (e.g. 36 km/h = 10 m/s).
bullets.ne: गति = दूरी ÷ समय। km/h → m/s: 5/18 ले गुणन (जस्तै 36 km/h = 10 m/s)।

bullets.en: Train crossing a platform: time = (train length + platform length) ÷ speed.
bullets.ne: रेलले प्लेटफर्म पार गर्दा: समय = (रेलको लम्बाइ + प्लेटफर्मको लम्बाइ) ÷ गति।

bullets.en: Time–work: 1 day's work = 1 ÷ total days. A and B together do 1/a + 1/b per day.
bullets.ne: काम–समय: 1 दिनको काम = 1 ÷ जम्मा दिन। A र B सँगै प्रतिदिन 1/a + 1/b गर्छन्।

bullets.en: Average = sum of values ÷ number of values.
Areas: triangle ½×b×h; rectangle l×b; circle πr²; square a².
bullets.ne: क्षेत्रफल: त्रिभुज ½×आधार×उचाइ; आयत ल×चौ; वृत्त πr²; वर्ग a²।

bullets.en: Sum 1 to n = n(n+1)/2. Sum of first n odd numbers = n² (e.g. first 8 odds = 64).
bullets.ne: 1 देखि n सम्मको योग = n(n+1)/2। पहिलो n बिजोर सङ्ख्याको योग = n² (जस्तै पहिलो 8 वटा = 64)।

bullets.en: Ratio a:b = a/b. Proportion: if a/b = c/d then a×d = b×c.
bullets.ne: अनुपात a:b = a/b। समानुपात: a/b = c/d भए a×d = b×c।

bullets.en: For two numbers: product = LCM × HCF.
